HICKORY.gloss: valuable tough heavy hardwood from various hickory trees
HICKORY.definition: Valuable tough heavy hardwood from various hickory trees.

CHOIR.gloss: a chorus that sings as part of a religious ceremony
CHOIR.definition: A chorus that sings as part of a religious ceremony.

CORKY.gloss: tainted in flavor by a cork containing excess tannin
CORKY.definition: (of wine) tainted in flavor by a cork containing excess tannin.

RICK.gloss: a painful muscle spasm especially in the neck or back
RICK.definition: A painful muscle spasm especially in the neck or back (`rick' and `wrick' are British).

CORK.gloss: outer bark of the cork oak
CORK.definition: Outer bark of the cork oak; used for stoppers for bottles etc.

ROCK.gloss: a lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
ROCK.definition: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter.
ROCK.example: He threw a rock at me.

CRY.definition: A loud utterance; often in protest or opposition.
CRY.example: The speaker was interrupted by loud cries from the rear of the audience.

CHI.gloss: the circulating life energy that in Chinese philosophy is thought to be inherent in…
CHI.definition: The circulating life energy that in Chinese philosophy is thought to be inherent in all things; in traditional Chinese medicine the balance of negative and positive forms in the body is believed to be essential for good health.
